notes:
### Sign in with Google works out of the box

Click the Continue with Google button on the login screen — no per-install setup needed. v1.0.18 required you to set environment variables yourself; v1.0.19 bakes the credentials into the signed binary.

### Tray panel merged into the dashboard

The standalone 360x540 tray panel is gone. The main TradeSpace window now opens the dashboard directly with native chrome (1440x900, resizable). The Connect button, MT5 / Telegram indicators, and settings toggles have moved to a new Bridge tab in the dashboard sidebar (System block, above Config). The system tray icon still works:

- Left-click: show / hide the dashboard window.
- Right-click: Show TradeSpace, Quit TradeSpace.

### What you will see on first launch after upgrading

The window opens at 1440x900 instead of the small 360x540 panel. If you had autolaunch / start-minimized / notifications / telemetry preferences set, they migrate over automatically (one-shot copy from the legacy settings file). The Bridge tab in the dashboard is the new home for those toggles.

### Email signup still works

Verified end-to-end: register, login, forgot-password, JWT round-trip, and an OAuth-only account correctly refusing the email/password path with a clear 'use the Google button' message.

### Honest disclosure

The Web-application client secret is recoverable from the binary with hex tools. Acceptable for invite-only beta with a small group of testers; the planned v1.1.0 hardening switches Google OAuth to PKCE (Desktop client, no secret) before public beta.
